name: ioq3-benchmark-workloads-v1
description: Immutable workload manifest for the API-neutral benchmark harness. This file is a pinned, read-only contract: the runner never modifies it, names must resolve against it, and any intended change requires a deliberate schema bump and review.

backends.name: opengl2
backends.description: OpenGL 2 backend. Emits JSONL timing samples to stdout when IOQ3_BENCH_JSONL is set.

backends.name: vrhi
backends.description: VRHI backend. Emits JSONL timing samples to stdout when IOQ3_BENCH_JSONL is set.

workloads.name: demo-frame
workloads.description: Demo playback frame workload: plays the pinned OpenArena demo while the engine emits one JSONL timing line per benchmarked frame.
